scope: original reference decisions, not deployed controls

layers.title: Mission and operating model
layers.proposed_owner: Executive sponsor and SOC service owner
layers.inputs: Business services, risk appetite, service obligations
layers.outputs: Mandate, scope, coverage model and decision rights

constraints.decision: Name the services, harms and decisions the SOC exists to support.
constraints.failure_mode: Tool activity replaces measurable service protection.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Sponsor-approved mission and prioritized business-service register.

constraints.decision: Separate continuous collection, staffed monitoring, on-call response and incident command.
constraints.failure_mode: A 24/7 dashboard is presented as 24/7 response capability.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Coverage timetable, on-call tests and explicit response commitments.

constraints.decision: Assign decision rights for monitoring, investigation, containment and risk acceptance.
constraints.failure_mode: Analysts or suppliers make business-impacting decisions without authority.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: RACI and authorized escalation/containment decision records.

constraints.decision: Choose internal, outsourced or shared delivery with a retained accountable owner.
constraints.failure_mode: MDR access and responsibilities fall between contract boundaries.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Contract/interface review and exercised joint handover.

constraints.decision: Set measurable objectives with denominators, unknowns and review triggers.
constraints.failure_mode: Activity totals imply effectiveness without known visibility.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Metric dictionary tied to service scope and evidence.

constraints.decision: Agree funding, change priorities and escalation for unresolved risk.
constraints.failure_mode: Platform purchasing displaces people, engineering and recovery investment.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Costed options, residual-risk decisions and quarterly roadmap.

layers.title: Asset, identity and business context
layers.inputs: Asset inventory, service dependencies, identity directories
layers.outputs: Versioned criticality and authority context

constraints.decision: Define the inventory boundary, exclusions and discovery sources.
constraints.failure_mode: Unknown assets disappear from the coverage denominator.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Inventory reconciliation with explicit unidentified and excluded records.

constraints.decision: Use tenant/provider-qualified immutable identifiers and historical validity.
constraints.failure_mode: Reused IP addresses or names merge unrelated systems.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Collision, reassignment and historical-lookup cases.

constraints.decision: Record criticality, data class, action owner and recovery dependencies.
constraints.failure_mode: Response choices ignore service impact or regulated information.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Business-owner review of critical paths and proposed actions.

constraints.decision: Preserve provenance, confidence and expiry for context joins.
constraints.failure_mode: Stale CMDB or graph context is treated as current truth.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Freshness thresholds, conflicting-source cases and unresolved joins.

constraints.decision: Connect human, workload and delegated identities without expanding authority.
constraints.failure_mode: A powerful service identity masks an unauthorized originating subject.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Subject/service/action/resource decision matrix and denied cases.

constraints.decision: Review changes to tools, assets, suppliers and destinations.
constraints.failure_mode: An integration silently creates a new data exit or response target.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Change event linked to ownership and boundary acceptance.

layers.title: Telemetry producers and visibility
layers.inputs: Endpoint, network, identity, cloud, SaaS, application, AI and OT events
layers.outputs: Source contracts and observable coverage

constraints.decision: Inventory each producer, required event class and accountable owner.
constraints.failure_mode: Agent installation is mistaken for collection of required events.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Source-by-event coverage matrix and deliberately missing-source test.

constraints.decision: Specify required fields, event time, observation time and uncertainty.
constraints.failure_mode: Incomplete identity or time data produces misleading correlations.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Representative records, missing-field handling and time-quality cases.

constraints.decision: Define source permissions, collection scope and sensitive-field handling.
constraints.failure_mode: Logging grants excessive access or captures secrets and unnecessary content.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Permission review and synthetic secret/privacy handling cases.

constraints.decision: Distinguish healthy source, silent source, blocked source and unknown visibility.
constraints.failure_mode: No events is interpreted as no threats.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Independent health signal and silence/permission-failure exercise.

constraints.decision: Authorize collection changes on production and safety-sensitive systems.
constraints.failure_mode: Sensor deployment or active polling disrupts essential operations.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Owner-approved change window and OT-safe collection review.

constraints.decision: Protect telemetry ingestion as an attacker-controlled input boundary.
constraints.failure_mode: Events trigger parser execution, unsafe rendering or agent instructions.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Malformed/oversized/adversarial records handled without privileged action.

layers.title: Edge collection and buffering
layers.inputs: Source events, connectivity state and local policies
layers.outputs: Bounded durable buffers and attributable forwarding

constraints.decision: Define buffer durability, capacity, priority and maximum outage assumptions.
constraints.failure_mode: An apparently resilient collector loses events on restart or disk exhaustion.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Restart, full-buffer and outage-duration observations.

constraints.decision: Declare duplicate/replay behavior and stable event identifiers.
constraints.failure_mode: Reconnect duplicates inflate alerts or repeat response actions.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Replay/dedup cases with preserved evidence lineage.

constraints.decision: Keep local identity, configuration, time and licensing dependencies visible.
constraints.failure_mode: A disconnected collector cannot authenticate, timestamp or operate.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Dependency inventory and local-operation failure exercise.

constraints.decision: Encrypt buffered data and separate key custody from routine operations.
constraints.failure_mode: Lost edge devices expose evidence or make recovery impossible.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Key/owner map, authorized recovery and denied-read checks.

constraints.decision: Control offline updates and imports with independent verification inputs.
constraints.failure_mode: A compromised or stale bundle becomes an authorized configuration.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Signer/digest/target/version checks and failed-admission cases.

constraints.decision: Expose backlog, dropped records, clock uncertainty and resynchronization status.
constraints.failure_mode: Central reporting silently treats an isolated site as current.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Local health report and freshness-aware central evidence view.

layers.title: Ingestion and streaming
layers.inputs: Authenticated batches, event streams and source metadata
layers.outputs: Durable queues, quarantine and delivery accounting

constraints.decision: Specify acknowledgement, durability and end-to-end delivery semantics.
constraints.failure_mode: Broker acknowledgement is presented as durable searchable evidence.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Crash/replay tests across acknowledgement and downstream checkpoint boundaries.

constraints.decision: Choose partition keys and make ordering scope explicit.
constraints.failure_mode: Cross-partition or cross-source records are given a false total order.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Tenant/resource partition review and out-of-order event cases.

constraints.decision: Apply quotas, backpressure and priority with explicit loss policies.
constraints.failure_mode: Bursts overload the platform or silently discard critical sources.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Burst/backlog exercise, priority decisions and loss accounting.

constraints.decision: Quarantine malformed, unauthorized or incompatible records.
constraints.failure_mode: Bad events poison processing or vanish without trace.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Dead-letter reason, protected raw sample and reprocessing workflow.

constraints.decision: Isolate tenants and regions in queues, credentials and routing.
constraints.failure_mode: Routing mistakes mix customers or violate placement constraints.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Cross-tenant/region negative cases at ingestion and storage.

constraints.decision: Authenticate callbacks and constrain retry loops and billing exposure.
constraints.failure_mode: Forged callbacks or infinite retries create work, cost or duplicate actions.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Callback authenticity tests, finite retries and cost/queue alerts.

layers.title: Schema, time and lineage
layers.inputs: Raw events, schema versions and parser rules
layers.outputs: Normalized records linked to source evidence

constraints.decision: Select and pin canonical schema versions and producer mappings.
constraints.failure_mode: Field meanings change while detections continue to run.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Versioned mapping contract and schema migration cases.

constraints.decision: Retain raw-to-normalized lineage according to approved privacy/retention policy.
constraints.failure_mode: Transformation loses investigative context or retains sensitive data indefinitely.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Traceable source references and controlled redaction/deletion tests.

constraints.decision: Preserve event time, observed time and explicit clock uncertainty.
constraints.failure_mode: Collector receipt time is substituted for the original event time.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Skew, invalid-time and uncertain-ordering cases.

constraints.decision: Treat missing, unmapped and conflicting fields as visible quality states.
constraints.failure_mode: A missing identity/classification becomes a benign default.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Quality report and quarantine/uncertainty behavior.

constraints.decision: Bound parsing, decompression and rendering of untrusted content.
constraints.failure_mode: Events exhaust resources or execute through analysts or downstream tools.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Resource limits and hostile-content handling cases.

constraints.decision: Test detection semantics on normalized data, not just schema validity.
constraints.failure_mode: A valid conversion changes matching, time windows or entity meaning.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Paired raw/normalized detection cases and backend-specific results.

layers.title: Security data platform and retention
layers.proposed_owner: Data platform, privacy and evidence owners
layers.inputs: Raw/normalized events, cases, classification and retention decisions
layers.outputs: Queryable authorized evidence and managed lifecycle

constraints.decision: Separate raw, normalized, indexed, aggregate and case-evidence retention.
constraints.failure_mode: One retention setting hides duplicated storage or deletes necessary evidence.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Tier-specific inventory and lifecycle policy with business owners.

constraints.decision: Enforce tenant, purpose, field and region authorization through every query/export path.
constraints.failure_mode: An analyst UI filter is bypassed by a lower-level query engine.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Storage/API/export negative cases and authorized controls.

constraints.decision: Model index, replication, compression, cardinality and query concurrency separately.
constraints.failure_mode: Raw ingest arithmetic is mistaken for SIEM capacity.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Declared assumptions followed by real workload-specific measurements.

constraints.decision: Control legal holds, deletion, backups and derived copies explicitly.
constraints.failure_mode: A deletion or hold applies only to the primary index.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Lifecycle dependency map and approved hold/deletion exercises.

constraints.decision: Design key ownership, rotation and restoration for each evidence tier.
constraints.failure_mode: Key loss makes archived evidence unusable or admins can decrypt all tenants.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Custody map, separation-of-duty checks and authorized restore evidence.

constraints.decision: Preserve portability and the meaning of exported evidence.
constraints.failure_mode: Vendor exit produces unqueryable data or loses identities and timestamps.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Schema/version manifest and import/re-query validation on an alternative path.

layers.title: Context and threat intelligence
layers.inputs: Indicators, business context, identities and supplier intelligence
layers.outputs: Bounded contextual joins with confidence and provenance

constraints.decision: Record intelligence provenance, confidence, expiry and allowed use.
constraints.failure_mode: A stale or untrusted indicator becomes an automatic blocking rule.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Source/expiry review and low-confidence or expired-indicator cases.

constraints.decision: Respect sharing markings, licensing, recipients and disclosure purpose.
constraints.failure_mode: Intelligence or customer evidence is redistributed outside permitted scope.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Recipient/purpose controls and denied-disclosure cases.

constraints.decision: Resolve entities with tenant/time boundaries and conflict handling.
constraints.failure_mode: Shared infrastructure or reused identifiers create false attribution.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Ambiguous joins preserved as unknown, with reviewer evidence.

constraints.decision: Distinguish observations, analytic inference and actor attribution.
constraints.failure_mode: A technique or indicator match is presented as proof of who attacked.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Claim-by-claim source trail and alternative explanations.

constraints.decision: Protect enrichment services from arbitrary URLs and resource exhaustion.
constraints.failure_mode: Attacker-supplied indicators trigger SSRF, egress or lookup storms.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Allowed destinations, bounded lookups and failure behavior.

constraints.decision: Retain historical context needed to reproduce a decision.
constraints.failure_mode: Later context updates rewrite the reason for an earlier alert.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Versioned enrichment snapshot and reproducible case reasoning.

layers.title: Detection engineering and content lifecycle
layers.inputs: Threat hypotheses, telemetry contracts and backend semantics
layers.outputs: Versioned rules, evaluation evidence and known gaps

constraints.decision: Define each detection as a falsifiable hypothesis with required data and expected behavior.
constraints.failure_mode: A technique label is mistaken for operational coverage.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Required source/field list, positive cases and limitations.

constraints.decision: Keep content, dependencies, schemas and backend versions under reviewable change control.
constraints.failure_mode: A parser or rule update silently changes protection.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Versioned change, reviewer, regression results and rollback artifact.

constraints.decision: Test benign cases, missing data, time boundaries and duplicates alongside attack cases.
constraints.failure_mode: A detector fires only on its authored example or floods analysts.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Held-out/benign cases, missed cases and correctly scoped rates.

constraints.decision: Translate and verify Sigma or other portable logic on the actual target backend.
constraints.failure_mode: A portable syntax file is assumed to have identical query semantics.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Backend-specific output and expected match/no-match evidence.

constraints.decision: Measure rule ownership, health, drift and retirement conditions.
constraints.failure_mode: Broken, stale or duplicate detections remain enabled without accountability.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Detection health report and owner-approved tuning/deprecation.

constraints.decision: Separate rule promotion from changing response authority.
constraints.failure_mode: A signed rule bundle indirectly authorizes destructive tool actions.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Independent response policy review and denied authority-expansion case.

layers.title: Analytics, UEBA and model assurance
layers.inputs: Scoped behavioral features, labels and evaluation data
layers.outputs: Risk signals with explanations and uncertainty

constraints.decision: Define the model task, population, feature rights and decision use.
constraints.failure_mode: Profiling expands beyond the approved security purpose.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Use-case/data review and excluded decisions.

constraints.decision: Preserve label provenance and prevent adversarial feedback from becoming truth.
constraints.failure_mode: Poisoned labels or analyst automation loops corrupt learning.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Label audit, feedback admission and poisoning/failure hypotheses.

constraints.decision: Test thresholds with base rates, subgroup behavior and practical alert burden.
constraints.failure_mode: High accuracy on an artificial set is presented as useful rare-event detection.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Confusion data, denominators, selection limits and analyst-load estimate.

constraints.decision: Track drift, feature availability and confidence decay.
constraints.failure_mode: A changed workforce or identity source invalidates the original baseline.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Re-evaluation triggers and degraded/unknown-state handling.

constraints.decision: Make explanations traceable to permitted source evidence.
constraints.failure_mode: A risk score invents causal attribution or hides unauthorized context.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Source-linked explanation, allowed evidence and alternative interpretations.

constraints.decision: Keep statistical risk separate from resource authorization and incident command.
constraints.failure_mode: A model score grants access, approves containment or declares an incident.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Independent policy/owner decision and rejected score-only action.

layers.title: Alert triage and analyst experience
layers.inputs: Detections, context, visibility states and service impact
layers.outputs: Prioritized review queues and attributable dispositions

constraints.decision: Prioritize by business impact, confidence, exposure and known visibility.
constraints.failure_mode: Numerical severity suppresses critical but uncertain cases.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Priority rationale, missing-context cases and owner escalation.

constraints.decision: Deduplicate without erasing distinct actors, resources or repeated harm.
constraints.failure_mode: A suppression rule hides continuing compromise.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Grouping/reopen cases and access to original contributing events.

constraints.decision: Make routing, acknowledgement, review age and overdue escalation observable.
constraints.failure_mode: An alert is delivered but never accepted by an accountable analyst.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Receipt-to-disposition trace and unattended-queue exercise.

constraints.decision: Render attacker-controlled content safely and mark AI-generated reasoning.
constraints.failure_mode: Events execute through the console or misleading suggestions appear authoritative.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Hostile-content UI review and clear source/AI attribution.

constraints.decision: Define analyst permissions and purposeful cross-team handover.
constraints.failure_mode: Convenient case sharing broadens tenant or sensitive-data access.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Case/field permissions and authorized/denied handover checks.

constraints.decision: Represent data gaps and detection outages separately from a quiet queue.
constraints.failure_mode: An empty dashboard is reported as effective security.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Visibility status surfaced in queue and executive report.

layers.title: Investigation, forensics and case evidence
layers.inputs: Scoped events, evidence references and investigation authority
layers.outputs: Reproducible case record and controlled evidence access

constraints.decision: Define case state, evidence scope, investigator authority and provenance.
constraints.failure_mode: The case combines unsupported assertions or unauthorized records.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Attributable evidence-to-claim index and subject/tenant access checks.

constraints.decision: Preserve original evidence separately from analysis and derived copies.
constraints.failure_mode: Normalization or analyst edits overwrite the source record.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Raw/derived distinction, protected original and reproducible transformations.

constraints.decision: Record custody, hashes and independent anchors with honest tamper limits.
constraints.failure_mode: A hash chain is claimed to prove completeness or trustworthy event time.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Alteration/gap checks and explicit anchor/time limitations.

constraints.decision: Handle uncertain time and partial ordering instead of fabricating chronology.
constraints.failure_mode: Clock skew creates a false sequence or attribution.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Event/observation times, uncertainty bounds and competing timelines.

constraints.decision: Control export recipients, fields, purpose and retention/hold decisions.
constraints.failure_mode: A valid investigator session permits unrestricted external disclosure.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Purpose-bound export and invalid-recipient/classification cases.

constraints.decision: Keep investigation continuity available when central systems fail.
constraints.failure_mode: Loss of case tooling destroys local decisions or evidence custody.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Offline procedure, locally accepted owners and reconciled handover.

layers.title: Response orchestration and action governance
layers.proposed_owner: Response service owners and business process owners
layers.inputs: Action proposals, independent identity, policy and approvals
layers.outputs: Bounded attributable actions and observed side effects

constraints.decision: Authorize subject, service, action, object, tenant and purpose independently of alert/model text.
constraints.failure_mode: A tool proposal or influential alert becomes execution authority.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Explicit action matrix and forged-context/foreign-resource denials.

constraints.decision: Bind high-impact approval to exact action, resource, scope and expiry.
constraints.failure_mode: An approval is reused for another account or a later incident.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Different-action/resource, expired and replayed approval cases.

constraints.decision: Specify idempotency, partial effects, retry limits and compensation boundaries.
constraints.failure_mode: Retries duplicate containment or imply rollback of irreversible actions.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Interrupted/repeated/partial-success observations and escalation paths.

constraints.decision: Apply per-tenant action budgets, rate limits and maximum blast radius.
constraints.failure_mode: One bad rule or compromised agent performs fleet-wide disruption.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Batch/rate/resource-limit cases and independent stop control.

constraints.decision: Authenticate callbacks and verify the resulting system state.
constraints.failure_mode: A forged success callback is counted as containment.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Authenticated receipt plus independently observed permitted state change.

constraints.decision: Define emergency and degraded authority without fail-open elevation.
constraints.failure_mode: Identity/provider outage grants unrestricted local response privileges.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Scoped emergency grants, expiry, accountability and denied escalation.

layers.title: AI copilots and bounded agents
layers.proposed_owner: AI platform, SOC and action-authority owners
layers.inputs: Untrusted events, scoped retrieval, models and tool proposals
layers.outputs: Evidence-linked assistance subject to independent decisions

constraints.decision: Treat logs, retrieved documents, prompts and tool descriptions as untrusted instructions.
constraints.failure_mode: Attacker-authored evidence redirects the assistant or adds authority.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Direct/indirect instruction cases and independently enforced tool policy.

constraints.decision: Apply subject/tenant/field authorization before retrieval enters model context.
constraints.failure_mode: Post-generation redaction is used to compensate for unauthorized retrieval.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Mixed-tenant/document cases and permitted-context controls.

constraints.decision: Register model/provider placement, retention, data use and offline dependencies.
constraints.failure_mode: Sensitive evidence exits to an unapproved model service.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Provider/data-boundary review and allowed/denied egress tests.

constraints.decision: Require evidence-linked outputs and preserve uncertainty and human decision ownership.
constraints.failure_mode: Confident generated text invents facts, chronology or approval.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Unsupported-claim cases, citations and clear proposed/accepted decision states.

constraints.decision: Bound loops, delegation, costs, concurrency and fallback behavior.
constraints.failure_mode: Agent failures cause uncontrolled spending, latency or cascading actions.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Budget/step/timeout tests and explicitly safe fallback.

constraints.decision: Admit model, retrieval and policy updates through controlled evaluation and rollback.
constraints.failure_mode: An approved assistant changes behavior after an unreviewed update.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Versioned admission, adversarial/benign cases and change-triggered re-evaluation.

layers.title: Threat hunting and adversary validation
layers.proposed_owner: Hunt lead, detection engineering and system owners
layers.inputs: Threat hypotheses, visibility records and authorized test scope
layers.outputs: Investigations, validated detections and explicit blind spots

constraints.decision: Authorize target, techniques, safety limits and data handling before simulation.
constraints.failure_mode: A coverage exercise becomes an unapproved production attack.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Written scope, domain-owner acceptance and stop conditions.

constraints.decision: Connect ATT&CK mapping to actual sources, fields, conditions and results.
constraints.failure_mode: Technique counts or heatmaps are presented as tested detection coverage.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Versioned mapping plus observed detect/miss outcomes.

constraints.decision: Maintain benign controls and negative findings with visibility qualifications.
constraints.failure_mode: A hunt with absent telemetry is reported as absence of compromise.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Required-data checks, negative-result limits and missing-evidence cases.

constraints.decision: Exercise prevention, detection, investigation and response as separate claims.
constraints.failure_mode: A blocked payload is mistaken for a tested full incident workflow.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Distinct stage observations and unresolved transitions.

constraints.decision: Convert confirmed findings into reviewed reusable content and regression evidence.
constraints.failure_mode: A one-off successful exercise does not improve sustained operations.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Finding-to-rule/playbook change and reproducible retest.

constraints.decision: Respect OT/process constraints and use safe synthetic alternatives where necessary.
constraints.failure_mode: Active testing threatens physical safety or essential availability.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Safety-owner authorization and bounded passive/simulation method.

layers.title: Incident command and business recovery
layers.proposed_owner: Incident commander, service owners and legal/privacy advisers
layers.inputs: Confirmed/uncertain incident evidence, dependencies and harm
layers.outputs: Accountable containment, communications and recovery decisions

constraints.decision: Define activation, authority, incident ownership and business impact criteria.
constraints.failure_mode: Uncertain alerts trigger conflicting command or premature public conclusions.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Escalation exercise and accepted command/decision records.

constraints.decision: Coordinate containment with safety, continuity and evidence preservation.
constraints.failure_mode: An automated security action causes greater business or physical harm.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Trade-off decision and process-owner-approved containment exercise.

constraints.decision: Establish secure communications and local decision channels during outages.
constraints.failure_mode: Compromised or unavailable identity/communications prevents command.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Out-of-band contact validation and loss-of-connectivity exercise.

constraints.decision: Assess notification duties for the entity, jurisdiction, incident and agreement.
constraints.failure_mode: Generic time windows are incorrectly treated as universally applicable law.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Current applicability review by the responsible legal/privacy owners.

constraints.decision: Restore identity, keys, configuration, data and pending-action state with explicit loss.
constraints.failure_mode: A database restore is presented as restoration of the whole SOC or business.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Measured scoped restoration, missing records and remaining dependencies.

constraints.decision: Preserve learning, decisions and follow-through after recovery.
constraints.failure_mode: Lessons remain narrative and recurring causes are not treated.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Owned corrective actions, priority decision and evidence-based retest.

layers.title: SOC identity and privileged access
layers.inputs: Human/workload identities, resource policy and emergency authority
layers.outputs: Scoped sessions, service grants and attributable administration

constraints.decision: Enforce resource/tenant/purpose permissions beneath consoles and workflow tools.
constraints.failure_mode: An authorized dashboard hides broad storage or API permissions.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Direct API/storage/export denial cases and legitimate-user controls.

constraints.decision: Separate platform admin, evidence reader, key custodian and action approver.
constraints.failure_mode: One operator can grant actions, decrypt records and erase the evidence.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Role/duty matrix and privileged-operation review.

constraints.decision: Use verified request-bound human and workload context with explicit delegation.
constraints.failure_mode: Agent or service credentials inherit broader authority than the user.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Issuer/audience/expiry/delegation checks and denied privilege expansion.

constraints.decision: Manage secret distribution, rotation, revocation and unavailable identity services.
constraints.failure_mode: Revoked credentials or stale local state remain usable without accountability.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Rotation/revocation/offline cases with bounded local authority.

constraints.decision: Make emergency access scoped, time-bounded and independently reviewable.
constraints.failure_mode: Emergency accounts become persistent unreviewed bypasses.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Grant, usage, expiry and review records.

constraints.decision: Inventory cryptographic purpose and migration dependencies separately.
constraints.failure_mode: A generic quantum-safe claim ignores authentication, signatures or archived evidence.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Purpose-specific crypto inventory and implementation-specific compatibility plan.

layers.title: Platform security, supply chain and change
layers.inputs: Infrastructure, detection/model packages and approved changes
layers.outputs: Hardened platform and traceable configuration releases

constraints.decision: Separate development, evaluation, production and privileged release contexts.
constraints.failure_mode: An untrusted contribution inherits production secrets or publish rights.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Environment/permission boundaries and untrusted-change cases.

constraints.decision: Pin and inventory components, build inputs and support dependencies.
constraints.failure_mode: Unknown plugins, libraries or licensing dependencies undermine recovery or offline operation.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Component/dependency register and lifecycle ownership.

constraints.decision: Verify package target, signer, digest, version and approval before admission.
constraints.failure_mode: Integrity checking accepts an unexpected signer, wrong site or replayed package.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Modified-artifact, wrong-target/signer and rollback/replay cases.

constraints.decision: Protect pipeline credentials, signing keys and privileged configuration.
constraints.failure_mode: Content authors can self-approve privileged platform changes.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Release-role separation and reviewed trust-input handling.

constraints.decision: Stage changes with measured rollback criteria and residual-state checks.
constraints.failure_mode: A reverted deployment leaves permissions, queues or model state changed.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Failed-update exercise and complete state-difference review.

constraints.decision: Harden the platform without equating container isolation with full trust.
constraints.failure_mode: A restricted container is called a secure SOC while identity and data controls remain absent.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Host/runtime/network/control-plane threat review and explicit missing evidence.

layers.title: Resilience and disaster recovery
layers.inputs: Failure domains, business objectives and dependency inventory
layers.outputs: Defined degraded modes and measured restoration

constraints.decision: Choose failure domains, quorum and placement within sovereignty constraints.
constraints.failure_mode: Redundant nodes share a dependency or replicate outside approved jurisdiction.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Dependency/failure-domain map and permitted placement review.

constraints.decision: Specify behavior during partition, source loss, queue loss and query outage.
constraints.failure_mode: Response continues on stale evidence or reporting silently implies normal service.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Partition/degraded-mode exercises and freshness-aware decisions.

constraints.decision: Treat replicated data, backups and immutable evidence as different protections.
constraints.failure_mode: Replication copies deletion/corruption and is called a recoverable backup.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Independent backup, deletion/corruption and clean-target restoration checks.

constraints.decision: Include identities, keys, policies, licenses and pending actions in recovery scope.
constraints.failure_mode: Recovered data is inaccessible or stale approvals re-enable response.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Full dependency checklist, authority-state restore and replay review.

constraints.decision: Set RPO/RTO per service and measure actual restoration and data loss.
constraints.failure_mode: Design targets become reported recovery achievements.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Timestamped scoped restore trials, missing records and unsuccessful attempts.

constraints.decision: Reconcile regional failback, duplicates and decision ownership.
constraints.failure_mode: Split-brain actors repeat actions or overwrite incident evidence.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Failover/failback cases with deduplication and authority reconciliation.

layers.title: Privacy, sovereignty and governance
layers.proposed_owner: Risk, privacy, jurisdiction and key owners
layers.inputs: Entity obligations, classifications, operator/supplier boundaries
layers.outputs: Applicable control decisions and bounded disclosure

constraints.decision: Define data, administrator, key, support, supplier and recovery authority independently.
constraints.failure_mode: Local workload placement is presented as complete sovereignty.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Boundary register with enforcement, contractual and observed evidence separated.

constraints.decision: Establish entity/jurisdiction/purpose applicability and source versions.
constraints.failure_mode: Framework mappings are mistaken for legal compliance or national accreditation.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Requirements register reviewed by authorized domain advisers.

constraints.decision: Minimize collection, AI context and exports according to approved purpose.
constraints.failure_mode: Security monitoring becomes uncontrolled sensitive-data accumulation.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Field-level rationale, retention and denied disclosure cases.

constraints.decision: Control cross-border replication, support, analytics and recovery paths.
constraints.failure_mode: A local primary database masks foreign backups or remote administrator access.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Workload/evidence/key/recovery placement map and independent assurance gaps.

constraints.decision: Define supplier assurance, exit, access and notification responsibilities.
constraints.failure_mode: Critical provider changes or failure leave no local owner or alternative.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Supplier review, dependency/exit plan and joint failure exercise.

constraints.decision: Give risks, exceptions and policy changes accountable owners and expiry.
constraints.failure_mode: Permanent exceptions silently weaken the architecture.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Accepted residual-risk record, expiration and re-evaluation trigger.

layers.title: Observability and effectiveness measures
layers.proposed_owner: SRE, detection and SOC service owners
layers.inputs: Pipeline/source health, cases, decisions and workload measurements
layers.outputs: Freshness-aware service reporting and operational alerts

constraints.decision: Measure source completeness, pipeline loss, delay and schema quality separately.
constraints.failure_mode: A healthy platform is reported while required sources are absent.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Independent health/coverage signals and deliberately missing-source exercise.

constraints.decision: Track current, delayed, missing and unverified evidence states.
constraints.failure_mode: A disconnected or failed site appears green centrally.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Freshness thresholds and reports aged beyond each threshold.

constraints.decision: Define detection, acknowledgement, investigation and containment timing precisely.
constraints.failure_mode: MTTD/MTTR combine incompatible start/end events or ignore censored cases.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Metric dictionary with known origin, uncertainty and excluded/missing events.

constraints.decision: Include alert burden, valid-case preservation and known misses in performance review.
constraints.failure_mode: Low alert volume is claimed as improved detection quality.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Benign/adversarial evaluation with sample and base-rate limitations.

constraints.decision: Protect health and audit signals from the same privileges that run the platform.
constraints.failure_mode: An attacker disables monitoring and also suppresses the evidence of failure.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Independent visibility path and privileged-disable investigation.

constraints.decision: Tie executive reports to scope, decisions and dated evidence.
constraints.failure_mode: Activity and technique totals are mistaken for reduced business risk.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Traceable board scorecard and unresolved-risk/visibility decisions.

layers.title: Capacity, cost and staffing
layers.proposed_owner: Platform economics and SOC workforce owners
layers.inputs: EPS, event sizes, retention, workload, staffing and unit-cost assumptions
layers.outputs: Planning estimates requiring measured validation

constraints.decision: Model steady ingest, bursts, outages and catch-up margin explicitly.
constraints.failure_mode: Average EPS masks backlog growth or no drain headroom.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Input assumptions plus measured workload-specific capacity and failure trials.

constraints.decision: Separate raw bytes, index overhead, compression, replicas and tier duration.
constraints.failure_mode: Storage estimates double-count or omit required retained copies.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Tier model reconciled with representative measured data.

constraints.decision: Account for API/query/egress/model costs and licenses alongside storage.
constraints.failure_mode: An affordable ingest estimate hides query or AI operating cost.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Transparent unit assumptions, sensitivity and cost guardrails.

constraints.decision: Distinguish staffed-seat coverage from workload-driven capacity.
constraints.failure_mode: A 24/7 rota is assumed to absorb unlimited alert volume.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Coverage and handling-time model with utilization and leave assumptions.

constraints.decision: Use distributions, burst behavior and censored outcomes before promising response latency.
constraints.failure_mode: A mean handling-time estimate is presented as a p95 queue guarantee.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Observed distributions and validated queue/scheduling experiment.

constraints.decision: Make trade-offs explicit for sampling, tiers, source selection and outsourcing.
constraints.failure_mode: Cost reduction silently removes important evidence or ownership.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Business-owner decision, visibility impact and residual-risk acceptance.

layers.title: Interoperability, integration and migration
layers.inputs: Source/query/case/tool contracts and vendor dependencies
layers.outputs: Controlled compatible interfaces and tested exit paths

constraints.decision: Version data, query, case and response contracts independently.
constraints.failure_mode: A working event connector is mistaken for operational interoperability.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Contract tests across fields, time semantics, identity and actions.

constraints.decision: Verify schema translation and detection behavior on each destination backend.
constraints.failure_mode: Equivalent-looking rules produce different matches or missed events.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Representative events and backend-specific query observations.

constraints.decision: Bound API limits, credentials, retries, callback trust and provider dependencies.
constraints.failure_mode: Integration fails on throttling or broad credentials expand response authority.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Rate/failure/permission cases and controlled retry behavior.

constraints.decision: Plan dual-run migration with deduplication and explicit authority cutover.
constraints.failure_mode: Two platforms generate duplicate cases or conflicting containment.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Parallel comparison, ownership switch and rollback decision.

constraints.decision: Test export/import of raw evidence, context, cases and content.
constraints.failure_mode: Vendor exit preserves files but loses useful meaning or custody.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Alternative-path reproduction with versioned manifests.

constraints.decision: Separate documented provider capability from your own deployment observation.
constraints.failure_mode: A reference diagram or product page is presented as tested platform behavior.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Source/version register and environment-specific evidence requirements.

layers.title: Assurance and acceptance evidence
layers.inputs: Design constraints, applicability, tests and residual decisions
layers.outputs: Traceable acceptance decisions and unresolved gaps

constraints.decision: Separate planned, documented, locally tested, environment-tested and independently reviewed evidence.
constraints.failure_mode: A template or local arithmetic check is promoted to production assurance.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Claim/evidence register with scope, date, inputs and limitations.

constraints.decision: Map selected controls to owners, implementation and actual evidence.
constraints.failure_mode: A framework crosswalk is reported as a completed assessment.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Control-to-evidence records with explicit unresolved gaps.

constraints.decision: Specify benign, denied, degraded and recovery acceptance cases.
constraints.failure_mode: A happy-path demo becomes a complete control claim.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Expected cases, actual outputs, failures and unknowns.

constraints.decision: Pin inputs, versions and source correspondence for reproducibility.
constraints.failure_mode: A result cannot be tied to the reviewed implementation or assumptions.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Input hashes, execution environment and repeatable commands.

constraints.decision: Review evidence age and invalidate claims on relevant changes.
constraints.failure_mode: A model, parser or identity change leaves an old test reported as current.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Review/expiry triggers and stale-evidence test.

constraints.decision: Require environment and business-owner acceptance before rollout or stronger claims.
constraints.failure_mode: Public reference work implies client adoption or independent validation.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Recorded responsible-owner decision and separately substantiated deployment results.
